method: premium_pct = (parallel buying midpoint / CBN selling rate - 1) x 100
nigeria_note: CBN selling rates are the latest available benchmarks dated 24 Nov. Nigeria parallel ranges combine two independent current-day observations updated at 13:06 and 13:27 WAT, independently verified 13:34 WAT on 25 Nov. The published extrema preserve cross-source dispersion rather than force a single quote. Aggregated from multiple independent market sources. Premium = parallel buying midpoint ÷ CBN selling rate − 1.
nigeria_market_note: Two independent current-day observations were combined; the ranges preserve corroborated cross-source dispersion and are indicative, not executable quotes.
